# Implementation Plan: Vendor Catalog Micro Frontend (React 18 + Vite)

The Vendor Catalog MFE is dedicated to product lifecycle management. Vendors can create raw product entries, view real-time inventory tables, assign categories, and monitor product statuses (`Draft` → `Enriching` → `Pending Review` → `Published`).
# Implementation Plan: AI Merchandising Copilot Micro Frontend (React 18)

The AI Merchandising Copilot MFE provides vendors with a side-by-side review interface. Vendors can compare raw product details against AI-generated SEO titles, marketing descriptions, feature bullet points, and auto-generated tags generated by the containerized SLM before approving or tweaking them
# Implementation Plan: Catalog Assistant Micro Frontend (React 18)

The Catalog Assistant MFE is an embeddable customer-facing widget. Rendered on product detail pages, it provides shoppers with a chat interface to ask natural language questions about product specifications, consuming real-time streaming RAG responses.

Building an end-to-end, production-ready E-Commerce Merchandising & Catalog AI platform from scratch for learning purposes.
